Thr. ... on 4 March, 2026

Author: Anil S. Kilor
Bench: Anil S. Kilor

 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Nagpur Bench : Nagpur
 Writ Petition No. 1902 of 2026
 Naresh Harilal Kataria and others Vs State of Maharashtra and others.

 or directions and Registrar's order
 Ms Ashwini Athalye, advocate with Ms Gargi V. Bhai, counsel for p
 Mr S.M. Ukey, Addl. G.P. for respondent Nos. 1 to 3/State.
Mr. J.B. Kasat, advocate for respondent No.4.
Coram : Anil S. Kilor and Raj D. Wakode, Jj.

2. Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that though there is an award, there is no compliance
with the Rehabilitation and Resettlement Scheme under Section 19 of the Right to Fair
Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
3.  Learned counsel for the petitioners submits that, at any time, respondents may come and demolish the shops of the petitioners.
4. In that view of the matter, issue notice to the respondents, returnable on 10/03/2026 at 2.30 p.m.

5. Mr. S.M. Ukey, learned Additional G.P. waives service of notice on behalf of respondent Nos. 1 to 3.
6.

Mr. J.B. Kasat, learned counsel waives service of notice on behalf of respondent No.4.
